title: 3.2.7 Challenges
description: Three Solar System extension challenges: add a Saturn ring, spawn random asteroids, or build a two-planet system.

steps.title: Pick a challenge
steps.instructions: Read content.md and choose one (or more) of the three challenges. Each extends your Solar System sketch.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer — the auto-grader accepts any of the three challenge signals.

requirements.title: Solar System base is intact
requirements.description: Orbit math using Math.cos or Math.sin on position.x is still present.

requirements.title: At least one challenge implemented
requirements.description: Code shows a Torus ring (Challenge 1), random() near Sphere creation (Challenge 2), or a named second planet like mars or asteroid (Challenge 3).
